terms.gloss: a layered cake of dough sheets and cheese
terms.comment: Catō’s layered cake of dough sheets (tracta) and cheese, built sheet by sheet (Agr. 76; Hor. Ep. I 10, 11): the nearest ancient thing to a layered cheese pastry. placenta is attested and genuinely layered, so it carries the idea of a layered cheese pastry honestly; the Romanian plăcintă family continues the Latin word.

phrases.english: In the morning we bought a warm cheese pastry.
